title: Native Higher-Call Commutant Trace-Orthogonality Audit: Operator Harmonic Zero-Trace Conservation, Purity-Deficit Parseval Identity, and Universal Unitary Readout Bounds

theorems.name: Operator Harmonic Adjoint Symmetry and Zero-Trace Orthogonality
theorems.statement: For any k-call schedule (epsilon, sigma), the matrix secret-Fourier harmonics rho_hat_(epsilon, sigma)(delta) satisfy rho_hat(-delta mod q) = rho_hat(delta)^dagger, Tr(rho_hat(0)) = 1, and Tr(rho_hat(delta)) = 0 for all delta != 0.

theorems.name: Exact Purity-Deficit Parseval Identity for Hilbert-Schmidt Variance
theorems.statement: The full operator Hilbert-Schmidt variance V_HS(epsilon, sigma) = E_s[||rho(s) - rho_bar||_F^2] equals the exact purity deficit 1 - Tr(rho_bar^2) = sum_(delta != 0) ||rho_hat(delta)||_F^2 = sum_(delta != 0) ||M_hat(delta)||_F^2 <= 1 - 1/D.

theorems.name: Exact Diagonal/Off-Diagonal Conservation and Universal Unitary Readout Bound
theorems.statement: For every post-circuit unitary V in U(D), the rotated readout L2 signal energy E_(epsilon, sigma)(V) = sum_x Var_s[<x|V rho(s) V^dagger|x>] plus the non-zero harmonic off-diagonal Frobenius norm squared equals 1 - Tr(rho_bar^2), so E_(epsilon, sigma)(V) <= 1 - Tr(rho_bar^2) <= 1 - 1/D for all V in U(D).
